name: DescriptionList
description: Mortar description list: label/value pairs for detail screens, in columns when wide and stacked when narrow, with optional row actions and a striped variant. Inside a Card body it drops its outer dividers, so a card with the title shows the list in a card.

props.title: string
props.items: { term: string; details: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode }[]
props.variant: "plain" | "striped" (default "plain"; striped shades alternate rows instead of dividing them)

contract.usage: Import { DescriptionList } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props. For a list in a card, put it in a Card and give the Card the title and description, not the list.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
